description: Are longs or shorts paying right now? Latest BTC perpetual funding rate, averaged across up to 4 exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX, Deribit; 8h settlement cadence). Returns the day's averaged value plus each exchange's own value (no moving average or Z-score — for the history use arena_get_funding_rate_history via arena_call_extended). Positive = longs pay shorts (bullish bias), negative = shorts pay longs (bearish bias). Read `coverage` before comparing values across dates: it says how many exchanges stand behind that day (4 = full average, 1 = a single exchange), and a day-over-day move can be a change in composition rather than in the market; `venues_present`/`venues_missing` name the exchanges. `provenance` grades the average (full = all exchanges, partial, thin = under half — never a basis for a verdict); fields="full" adds the venue spread in bps and the min/max interval of the venue values. A value of exactly 0.0001 (0.01 % per 8h) on many days is the exchanges' base-rate clamp on USDT perpetuals, not a cap in our pipeline: it means "no premium beyond the base rate", and values above it are real market readings. [Free tier]

fields.description: Omit for the default response, which carries `provenance` in short form (grade full/partial/thin, sources_used, sources_expected). 'full' adds the long form: sources_missing (named), sources (licence attribution names), grade_reason, as_of — plus per-part provenance where the composite has parts. A `thin` grade (under half the expected inputs) is never a basis for a verdict or a ranking.
